from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

headers = {cell.value: cell.column for cell in ws[1] if cell.value is not None}
print('Sheet:', ws.title, 'Headers:', headers)

sales_key = next((k for k in headers if str(k).strip().lower() in ('sales', 'revenue', 'sales revenue', 'net sales')), None)
profit_key = next((k for k in headers if str(k).strip().lower() in ('profit', 'gross profit', 'net profit', 'operating profit', 'total profit')), None)
if sales_key is None or profit_key is None:
    raise SystemExit(f'Required columns not found (sales_key={sales_key}, profit_key={profit_key})')

sales_col = headers[sales_key]
profit_col = headers[profit_key]
new_col = ws.max_column + 1

header = ws.cell(row=1, column=new_col, value='Profit Margin %')
header.font = Font(bold=True)
header.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')

for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=new_col)
    cell.value = f'=IFERROR({ws.cell(row=row, column=profit_col).coordinate}/{ws.cell(row=row, column=sales_col).coordinate},"")'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'

wb.save('sales_data.xlsx')
print(f'Added Profit Margin % at column {ws.cell(row=1, column=new_col).coordinate} (sales={ws.cell(row=1, column=sales_col).coordinate}, profit={ws.cell(row=1, column=profit_col).coordinate})')

import zipfile
import shutil
import os
import csv
import subprocess
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
R = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
XMLNS = 'http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace'

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'

def col_idx(ref):
    n = 0
    for ch in ref:
        if ch.isalpha():
            n = n * 26 + (ord(ch.upper()) - 64)
    return n

def idx_col(n):
    s = ''
    while n > 0:
        n, rem = divmod(n - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + rem) + s
    return s

def cell_text(c, shared):
    v = c.find(f'{{{M}}}v')
    if v is None or v.text is None:
        return None
    t = c.get('t')
    if t == 's':
        return shared[int(v.text)]
    if t == 'inlineStr':
        return ''.join(x.text or '' for x in c.iter(f'{{{M}}}t'))
    return v.text

# ---- read original workbook ----
zf = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
names = zf.namelist()
wb_root = ET.fromstring(zf.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
rels = ET.fromstring(zf.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rel_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}

shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
    ss = ET.fromstring(zf.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in ss.findall(f'{{{M}}}si'):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(f'{{{M}}}t')))

SALES_KEYS = {'sales', 'revenue', 'net sales', 'sales revenue', 'total sales'}
PROFIT_KEYS = {'profit', 'gross profit', 'net profit', 'operating profit', 'total profit', 'gross profit margin'}

target = None
for sheet in wb_root.find(f'{{{M}}}sheets'):
    name = sheet.get('name')
    rid = sheet.get(f'{{{R}}}id')
    tgt = rel_map.get(rid, '')
    if not tgt.startswith('xl/'):
        tgt = 'xl/' + tgt.lstrip('/')
    if tgt not in names:
        continue
    ws_root = ET.fromstring(zf.read(tgt))
    header_row = None
    sales_col = profit_col = None
    for row in ws_root.iter(f'{{{M}}}row'):
        r = int(row.get('r'))
        if r > 5:
            break
        vals = {}
        for c in row.findall(f'{{{M}}}c'):
            vals[col_idx(c.get('r'))] = cell_text(c, shared)
        sk = next((k for k in vals.values() if k and str(k).strip().lower() in SALES_KEYS), None)
        pk = next((k for k in vals.values() if k and str(k).strip().lower() in PROFIT_KEYS), None)
        if sk is not None and pk is not None:
            header_row = r
            sales_col = next(i for i, v in vals.items() if v == sk)
            profit_col = next(i for i, v in vals.items() if v == pk)
            break
    if header_row is not None:
        target = (name, tgt, ws_root)
        break

if target is None:
    raise SystemExit('Could not find a sheet with Sales and Profit columns')

name, tgt, ws_root = target
print(f'Target sheet: {name} ({tgt}), header row {header_row}, sales col {idx_col(sales_col)}, profit col {idx_col(profit_col)}')

max_col = max(col_idx(c.get('r')) for row in ws_root.iter(f'{{{M}}}row') for c in row.findall(f'{{{M}}}c'))
new_col = max_col + 1
new_letter = idx_col(new_col)
print(f'New column: {new_letter} (Profit Margin %)')

# ---- percentage number format style ----
styles_root = ET.fromstring(zf.read('xl/styles.xml'))
cell_xfs = styles_root.find(f'{{{M}}}cellXfs')
num_fmts = styles_root.find(f'{{{M}}}numFmts')
used_ids = {int(n.get('numFmtId')) for n in num_fmts} if num_fmts is not None else set()
fmt_id = max([i for i in used_ids if i >= 164] + [164]) + 1
if num_fmts is None:
    num_fmts = ET.Element(f'{{{M}}}numFmts')
    num_fmts.set('count', '0')
    cell_xfs_index = list(styles_root).index(cell_xfs)
    styles_root.insert(cell_xfs_index, num_fmts)
num_fmts.append(ET.fromstring(f'<numFmt numFmtId="{fmt_id}" formatCode="0.0%"/>'))
num_fmts.set('count', str(len(num_fmts.findall(f'{{{M}}}numFmt'))))

new_style_idx = len(cell_xfs.findall(f'{{{M}}}xf'))
xf = ET.fromstring(f'<xf numFmtId="{fmt_id}" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/>')
cell_xfs.append(xf)
cell_xfs.set('count', str(len(cell_xfs.findall(f'{{{M}}}xf'))))

# header style: reuse the style of the profit header cell if present
header_style = None
for row in ws_root.iter(f'{{{M}}}row'):
    if int(row.get('r')) == header_row:
        for c in row.findall(f'{{{M}}}c'):
            if col_idx(c.get('r')) == profit_col:
                header_style = c.get('s')
        break

# ---- add cells ----
for row in ws_root.iter(f'{{{M}}}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    cells = row.findall(f'{{{M}}}c')
    if r == header_row:
        xml = f'<c r="{new_letter}{r}" t="inlineStr">'
        if header_style is not None:
            xml += f' s="{header_style}"'
        xml += f'<is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c>'
        new_cell = ET.fromstring(xml)
    else:
        new_cell = ET.fromstring(
            f'<c r="{new_letter}{r}" s="{new_style_idx}"><f>IFERROR({idx_col(profit_col)}{r}/{idx_col(sales_col)}{r},"")</f></c>')
    pos = 0
    for c in cells:
        if col_idx(c.get('r')) < new_col:
            pos += 1
        else:
            break
    row.insert(pos, new_cell)

dim = ws_root.find(f'{{{M}}}dimension')
if dim is not None:
    ref = dim.get('ref', '')
    if ':' in ref and not ref.startswith('A1:'):
        dim.set('ref', f'A1:{new_letter}{ws_root.findall(f"{{{M}}}sheetData/{{{M}}}row")[-1].get("r")}')
    else:
        dim.set('ref', f'A1:{new_letter}{ws_root.findall(f"{{{M}}}sheetData/{{{M}}}row")[-1].get("r")}')

# ---- write new workbook ----
os.makedirs('_recalc', exist_ok=True)
tmp = SRC + '.new'
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
    for item in zf.infolist():
        if item.filename == tgt:
            data = ET.tostring(ws_root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
        elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = ET.tostring(styles_root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
        else:
            data = zf.read(item.filename)
        out.writestr(item, data)
zf.close()
os.replace(tmp, SRC)
print('Saved', SRC)

# ---- recalculate with LibreOffice ----
conv = '_recalc/sales_data.xlsx'
try:
    subprocess.run(['soffice', '--headless', '--norestore', '--convert-to', 'xlsx',
                    '--outdir', '_recalc', SRC], check=True, timeout=120,
                   capture_output=True, text=True)
    os.replace(conv, SRC)
    print('Recalculated with LibreOffice')
    recalc_ok = True
except Exception as e:
    print('Recalc via LibreOffice failed:', e)
    recalc_ok = False

# ---- verify ----
zf2 = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
ws2 = ET.fromstring(zf2.read(tgt))
errors = []
values = []
for row in ws2.iter(f'{{{M}}}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    for c in row.findall(f'{{{M}}}c'):
        if col_idx(c.get('r')) == new_col and r > header_row:
            v = c.find(f'{{{M}}}v')
            f = c.find(f'{{{M}}}f')
            val = v.text if v is not None else None
            values.append((r, f.text if f is not None else None, val))
            if val and str(val).startswith('#'):
                errors.append(f'{new_letter}{r}={val}')
zf2.close()

print('Sample computed margins:')
for r, f, v in values[:5]:
    print(f'  row {r}: {f} -> {v}')
print('Formula count:', len(values))
print('Errors:', errors if errors else 'none')
print('Recalc status:', 'ok' if recalc_ok else 'not run (formulas kept, values computed on open)')

    cells = row.findall(f'{{{M}}}c')
    if r == header_row:
        xml = f'<c r="{new_letter}{r}" t="inlineStr">'
        if header_style is not None:
            xml += f' s="{header_style}"'
        xml += f'<is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c>'
        new_cell = ET.fromstring(xml)
    else:
        new_cell = ET.fromstring(
            f'<c r="{new_letter}{r}" s="{new_style_idx}"><f>IFERROR({idx_col(profit_col)}{r}/{idx_col(sales_col)}{r},"")</f></c>')
    pos = 0
    for c in cells:
        if col_idx(c.get('r')) < new_col:
            pos += 1
        else:
            break
    row.insert(pos, new_cell)

dim = ws_root.find(f'{{{M}}}dimension')
if dim is not None:
    ref = dim.get('ref', '')
    if ':' in ref and not ref.startswith('A1:'):
        dim.set('ref', f'A1:{new_letter}{ws_root.findall(f"{{{M}}}sheetData/{{{M}}}row")[-1].get("r")}')
    else:
        dim.set('ref', f'A1:{new_letter}{ws_root.findall(f"{{{M}}}sheetData/{{{M}}}row")[-1].get("r")}')

# ---- write new workbook ----
os.makedirs('_recalc', exist_ok=True)
tmp = SRC + '.new'
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
    for item in zf.infolist():
        if item.filename == tgt:
            data = ET.tostring(ws_root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
        elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = ET.tostring(styles_root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
        else:
            data = zf.read(item.filename)
        out.writestr(item, data)
zf.close()
os.replace(tmp, SRC)
print('Saved', SRC)

# ---- recalculate with LibreOffice ----
conv = '_recalc/sales_data.xlsx'
try:
    subprocess.run(['soffice', '--headless', '--norestore', '--convert-to', 'xlsx',
                    '--outdir', '_recalc', SRC], check=True, timeout=120,
                   capture_output=True, text=True)
    os.replace(conv, SRC)
    print('Recalculated with LibreOffice')
    recalc_ok = True
except Exception as e:
    print('Recalc via LibreOffice failed:', e)
    recalc_ok = False

# ---- verify ----
zf2 = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
ws2 = ET.fromstring(zf2.read(tgt))
errors = []
values = []
for row in ws2.iter(f'{{{M}}}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    for c in row.findall(f'{{{M}}}c'):
        if col_idx(c.get('r')) == new_col and r > header_row:
            v = c.find(f'{{{M}}}v')
            f = c.find(f'{{{M}}}f')
            val = v.text if v is not None else None
            values.append((r, f.text if f is not None else None, val))
            if val and str(val).startswith('#'):
                errors.append(f'{new_letter}{r}={val}')
zf2.close()

print('Sample computed margins:')
for r, f, v in values[:5]:
    print(f'  row {r}: {f} -> {v}')
print('Formula count:', len(values))
print('Errors:', errors if errors else 'none')
print('Recalc status:', 'ok' if recalc_ok else 'not run (formulas kept, values computed on open)')
